issue.title: Populate Next theme tokens from Figma Foundations (Hardware default)
issue.body:
## Context

Follow-up to #615 (Legacy/Next UI version foundation). The runtime switch and empty Next overrides landed in #616. This ticket populates the **Next** theme from the Figma Foundations page so Settings → Next actually resolves redesign tokens.

Figma: [ETEN × Fluent — Foundations](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2308-6)

## Scope

1. Encode Figma Foundations into Next-only theme modules (primitives, roles, spacing, radius, typography sizes).
2. Default Next app chrome uses the **Hardware** role mode (light panels/screens).
3. Expose **Canvas** and **Accent** role modes as Next-only tokens for future drafting/overlay work — do not force them into Legacy or into every screen yet.
4. Map Hardware roles onto the existing `Theme` shape via `nextOverrides` so proving consumers (`useTheme` / `ScreenContainer` / root nav) show Next colors when UI version is Next.
5. Do **not** redesign screens/components structurally; do **not** change Legacy tokens.
6. Do **not** add UI frameworks.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Next theme includes Figma color primitives (`bone`, `blue`, `red`, white/black) as source values.
2. Color roles for Canvas / Hardware / Accent are represented in code and resolve to primitive hexes.
3. Active Next theme (via `resolveTheme('next')` / `useTheme`) uses **Hardware** for mapped `Theme.colors` (background, foreground, primary, card, border, recordAccent, etc. where a clear mapping exists).
4. Spacing and radius Next overrides match Figma (`space-*`, `radius-*`) where they map cleanly onto existing `Theme.spacing` / `Theme.radius` keys; document any Figma steps that have no Legacy key yet.
5. Typography size/weight overrides for Next where they map to existing `Theme.typography` without inventing a full type system (family remains System/TBD per Figma).
6. Legacy theme snapshot and Legacy visuals unchanged when `uiVersion === 'legacy'`.
7. Focused tests: Next Hardware mapping values, Canvas/Accent role tables present, Legacy still resolves to `legacyTheme`.
8. Update `docs/guides/ui-version-theming.md` with Figma source link and Hardware-default note.
9. No mass screen migration; no domain behavior forks.

## Non-goals

- Implementing tactile/effects/gradients/bevels as first-class RN chrome (document as follow-up).
- Choosing final font families (Figma: TBD).
- Splitting screens into Legacy/Next presentations.
- Changing Settings UX beyond what #615 already added.

## Notes

- Abstraction budget: build Next token modules + Hardware→Theme bridge only.
- Needs QA: Yes (Next toggle will change colors).
